definition: WARD (Shade): you cannot be Dimmed until your next turn starts.
window: From resolve (or interrupt) to the start of your next turn.
does_not: Does not block Interrupt, Boost, Draw, or anything but Dim. Passive: needs no action.

contrast.interrupt: Ward is passive and blocks only Dim; Interrupt is an action that cancels any one effect.
contrast.unstoppable: Ward protects your Glow; Unstoppable protects a card's effect.
